tools.name: create_customer
tools.description:
This tool will create a customer in Stripe.

It takes two arguments:
- name (str): The name of the customer.
- email (str, optional): The email address of the customer.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description:
This tool will create a payment link in Stripe.

It takes two arguments:
- price (str): The ID of the price to create the payment link for.
- quantity (int): The quantity of the product to include.

price.description: The ID of the price to create the payment link for, e.g. price_1MoBy5LkdIwHu7ixZhnattbh

quantity.description: The quantity of the product to include.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description:
This tool will fetch a list of Invoices from Stripe.

It takes two arguments:
- customer (str, optional): The ID of the customer, e.g. cus_NeZwdNtLEOXuvB.
- limit (int, optional): The number of invoices to return (1-100).

tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search the Stripe documentation (https://docs.stripe.com) for the given question and return the relevant sections. Always cite the page URL in the answer. Never include secret keys (sk_live_...) in a question.

question.description: The question to search for, in natural language

language.description: Programming language of the code samples
